title: Extraction of High Molecular Weight DNA from Bacteriophage
author: Mitchell Hedges

steps.title: Prepare 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Make a 70 % (v/v) ethanol solution using molecular‑grade ethanol and UltraPure water (≈400 µL per sample).

steps.title: Prepare 2 M ZnCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.68 g ZnCl₂, dissolve in 2.5 mL molecular‑grade water, add 2.5 µL 32 % (v/v) HCl, swirl until fully dissolved, and verify pH is between 4.5 and 7.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL 32 % HCl and swirl gently.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Combine 200 µL of 0.5 M molecular‑grade EDTA with 800 µL UltraPure water.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL 0.5 M EDTA to a tube.
Add 800 µL UltraPure water and mix.

steps.title: Make Digestion Master Mix
steps.instruction: For each 700 µL lysate, prepare 78 µL of Digestion Master Mix on ice by mixing DNase I, RNase A and 10× DNase I reaction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL DNase I (up to 5 µL if needed).
Add 1 µL RNase A (up to 5 µL if needed).
Add 76 µL 10× DNase I reaction buffer to reach 78 µL total.

steps.title: Add Digestion Mix to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 78 µL Digestion Master Mix to 700 µL syringe‑filtered (0.22 µm) bacteriophage lysate in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube and mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Digest host nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 30 min at 37 °C in a Thermomixer without shaking.

steps.title: Add zinc chloride
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 % (v/v) of the freshly prepared 2 M ZnCl₂ solution to achieve a final Zn²⁺ concentration of 50 mM, then mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and 250 µL Cell Lysis Solution to the sample, then pipette up and down 25 times.

steps.title: Incubate with enzymes
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 5 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 1 min.

steps.title: Heat at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate for 1 h at 56 °C in a Thermomixer set to 500 rpm; pre‑cool the centrifuge to 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL protein precipitation solution and invert the tube 50 times to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Ice incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 rcf, 4 °C, for 10 min.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube without disturbing the protein pellet.

steps.title: Secondary centrifugation (8000 rcf)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the transferred supernatant at 8 000 rcf, room temperature, for 10 min and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: EDTA wash
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 0.1 M EDTA solution to the pellet, pipette gently to break up the pellet (no need to resuspend).

substeps.instruction: Pipette gently to break the pellet.

steps.title: Room‑temp incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Final protein spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 rcf, room temperature, for 5 min (place tube hinge up to locate pellet).

steps.title: DNA precipitation with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL isopropanol to the supernatant in a new LoBind tube and invert 50 times to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Remove isopropanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully draw off the supernatant at the air‑liquid interface with a pipette, leaving the invisible DNA pellet undisturbed.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL 70 % (v/v) ethanol to the pellet and invert 10 times to wash.

steps.title: Wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 × g (temperature not specified) for 1 min.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL DNA hydration solution or nuclease‑free water to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate at 65 °C for 1 h to dissolve the DNA, or store the tube at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA resuspended in water at –20 °C; if resuspended in DNA hydration solution, store up to 1 month at 4 °C.
